question: What does Mark say about the hostel?

options.text: It was cheaper than he had expected.
options.note: Про цену говорят, но «no surprises» значит «как и ожидал», а не «дешевле».

options.text: It was close to the city centre.
options.note: «Miles from the centre» — это ожидание. «Turned out» — факт: десять минут пешком.
Про атмосферу Марк не говорит ни слова.

transcript.text: Today we're talking to Mark Hughes, who has just come back from his first solo trip.
Hi, thanks for having me.
So why Lisbon?
Honestly, the flights were cheap, and a friend of mine had been there twice.
Did you plan much before you went?
Not really. I booked a hostel, downloaded a map, and that was about it.
So, you spent a week there last spring.
That's right, my first trip on my own.
And what about the hostel itself?
I'd read that the hostel was miles from the centre, but it turned out to be a ten-minute walk.
Was it easy to book?
Very. I did it on my phone in about two minutes.
And the other guests?
Mostly students from Germany and Spain.
Price-wise, it cost exactly what the website said. No surprises there.
What surprised you most about the city?
The hills. Nobody warns you how steep the streets are.
Would you go back?
Definitely, but next time in autumn, when it's less crowded.
Any advice for people travelling alone for the first time?
Keep a paper copy of your bookings. My phone died on day two.
That sounds stressful.
It was, for about an hour. Then I found a café with a charger and very good coffee.
Mark, thank you for talking to us.
My pleasure.

steps.say: Вопрос: что Марк говорит о хостеле.
I'd read that the hostel was miles from the centre, but it turned out to be a ten-minute walk.
«Miles from the centre» — это то, что он читал. После «but it turned out» идёт факт: десять минут пешком.
Значит, верный ответ второй: хостел близко к центру.
Price-wise, it cost exactly what the website said. No surprises there.
Про цену говорят, поэтому тянет выбрать первый вариант. Но «no surprises» значит «как и ожидал», а не «дешевле».
Это и есть подвох: тему назвали, а вывод другой.
А про атмосферу Марк не говорит ничего.
